hypothesis: A small set of complex source-frequency responses identifies enough of an unseen wave system to answer a joint-held-out source-frequency query at a fixed receiver array more accurately than interpolation, low-rank completion, and nearest-system retrieval.

dataset.split_source: archive system split; 112 train / 24 validation / 24 test

receiver_arrays.construction: Cartesian 8x8 interior grid with rounded indices linspace(4, grid_size-5, 8)
receiver_arrays.selection_rule: choose once on validation; do not select on test

query_protocol.q1: target frequency absent from context; target source appears in context
query_protocol.q2: target source absent from context; target frequency appears in context
query_protocol.q3: target source and target frequency both absent from context

candidate_models: query-to-context cross-attention only after the DeepSets gate
primary_metric: raw complex relative L2 averaged first over frozen queries per physical system and then over systems

promotion_gate.context_scaling: Q3 error must decrease consistently from K=1 to K=8
promotion_gate.safety: Q1 or Q2 and IID must not degrade by more than 2 percent when adding a representation component

deferred: learned active policy and reinforcement learning
